summary: Electrovaya Inc. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report) furnishing a press release dated November 10, 2026, announcing management's participation in four investor conferences: Craig-Hallum Alpha Select (Nov 17, New York, 1x1s), ROTH Technology (Nov 18, New York, 1x1s), UBS Global Industrials Transportation (Dec 2-3, Manalapan, 1x1s), and Bernstein/SocGen Industrials Energy Forum (Dec 8, New York, fireside and 1x1s). No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed; exhibit references to an 'Offering' and use of proceeds appear to be boilerplate. Watch for financing or strategic news around the conference calendar.
